from service import score


def test_all_inputs_affect_cache():
    store = {}
    calls = {"n": 0}
    def compute():
        calls["n"] += 1
        return calls["n"]

    # baseline
    r1 = score(store, "jobA", 1, 2, compute)
    assert r1 == 1, r1
    assert calls["n"] == 1

    # change job_text -> recompute
    r2 = score(store, "jobB", 1, 2, compute)
    assert r2 == 2, r2
    assert calls["n"] == 2

    # change profile_version -> recompute
    r3 = score(store, "jobA", 3, 2, compute)
    assert r3 == 3, r3
    assert calls["n"] == 3

    # change criteria_version -> recompute
    r4 = score(store, "jobA", 1, 5, compute)
    assert r4 == 4, r4
    assert calls["n"] == 4


def test_unchanged_inputs_reuse_even_none():
    store = {}
    calls = {"n": 0}
    def compute():
        calls["n"] += 1
        return calls["n"]

    r1 = score(store, "jobA", None, None, compute)
    assert r1 == 1
    assert calls["n"] == 1

    # same inputs including None -> reuse
    r2 = score(store, "jobA", None, None, compute)
    assert r2 == 1
    assert calls["n"] == 1

    # None profile but different criteria -> recompute
    r3 = score(store, "jobA", None, 7, compute)
    assert r3 == 2
    assert calls["n"] == 2

    # None criteria but different profile -> recompute
    r4 = score(store, "jobA", 9, None, compute)
    assert r4 == 3
    assert calls["n"] == 3


def test_no_ambiguous_concatenation():
    from cache import make_key
    # keys must be tuples (unambiguous), not strings
    k1 = make_key("ab", 1, 2)
    k2 = make_key("a", 1, 22)
    assert isinstance(k1, tuple), type(k1)
    assert k1 != k2
    # distinct inputs must produce distinct keys
    assert make_key("x", 1, 2) != make_key("x", 2, 1)
    assert make_key("x", 1, 2) != make_key("y", 1, 2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_all_inputs_affect_cache()
    test_unchanged_inputs_reuse_even_none()
    test_no_ambiguous_concatenation()
    print("ALL TESTS PASSED")

def make_key(text, profile, criteria):
    return (text, profile, criteria)
